subject: Agent Vigil Continuity Staple consumer verification

included: Ed25519 signature verification against a pinned public key
receipt, commit, environment, policy, chain-tip, sequence, clock, and expiry checks
bounded file read and JSON parsing

rules: Run from a clean exact Git commit after building dist/cli.js.
Use one valid short-lived CURRENT staple and a pinned Ed25519 public key.
Freeze the verification time inside the staple lifetime so clock drift cannot change the result.
Record every sample and calculate percentiles from the sorted observed durations.
Do not present a single-machine maintainer run as independent, universal, or competitor-comparative evidence.
